# type

Return the Lua type name.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `lua.type` |
| Origin | Lua base |
| Category | Lua Base |
| Family | Function |
| Monaco kind | `function` |
| Format | `type(value)` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `type(value)` |

## Example

```lua
type(value)
```
